stories.title: Büchermachen als Dienst am Menschen: Die Zürcher Verlegerin Anne Rüffer ist mit 69 gestorben

en.title: Book publishing as service to humanity: Zurich publisher Anne Rüffer dies at 69
en.summary: Anne Rüffer, a Zurich-based publisher known for her focus on existential themes and social impact in her book selections, has passed away at age 69.

stories.title: Börsenbarometer SMI – SMI-Zusammensetzung: Darum sind neu Sandoz und Galderma drin

en.title: Stock market barometer SMI – SMI composition: Why Sandoz and Galderma are now included
en.summary: The composition of the Swiss Market Index changes on Monday, with Sandoz and Galderma joining the benchmark index.

stories.title: En direct, guerre en Ukraine – Volodymyr Zelensky et Donald Trump ont convenu de se rencontrer à New York

en.title: Live, war in Ukraine – Volodymyr Zelensky and Donald Trump agreed to meet in New York
en.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky and U.S. President Donald Trump agreed during a phone call to hold a meeting in New York in the near future.

stories.title: Krieg im Nahen Osten – Irans Militär droht den USA und deren Verbündeten

en.title: War in the Middle East – Iran's military threatens the US and its allies
en.summary: Iran's military has warned that Gulf region states supporting a US attack on Iran would be considered accomplices.

stories.title: Les Etats-Unis ont discuté avec la Chine d'un «mécanisme» de dialogue sur l'IA

en.title: The United States discussed with China a "mechanism" for dialogue on artificial intelligence
en.summary: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent proposed to China a notification mechanism between the two countries regarding artificial intelligence incidents affecting national security and advocated for transparency in AI development.

stories.title: La Chine et les Etats-unis ont discuté d'un mécanisme de dialogue sur l'IA

en.title: China and the United States discussed a dialogue mechanism on AI
en.summary: The United States proposed to China the creation of a dialogue mechanism between the two powers regarding artificial intelligence, amid concerns about the technology potentially becoming uncontrolled.

stories.title: Purge politique, débat déserté par les candidats et vote en public: en Russie, le triomphe garanti du parti de Vladimir Poutine

en.title: Political purge, debate deserted by candidates and public voting: in Russia, the guaranteed triumph of Vladimir Putin's party
en.summary: Russia's United Russia party won legislative elections held on Sunday, expected to exceed its 2021 results, following a campaign widely mocked on social media in a contest considered to provide legitimacy only to the Kremlin.

stories.title: Krieg in der Ukraine – Selenski will Trump in New York treffen

en.title: War in Ukraine – Zelenskyy wants to meet Trump in New York
en.summary: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy has agreed to meet with US President Trump in New York.

stories.title: En Russie, le parti de Vladimir Poutine donné large vainqueur aux élections législatives

en.title: In Russia, Vladimir Putin's party given clear victor in legislative elections
en.summary: Putin's United Russia party won 57.5 percent of votes in legislative elections concluded Sunday, with voting marked by Ukrainian drone attacks and cyber-attacks.

stories.title: Le parti de Vladimir Poutine donné vainqueur des premières élections depuis la guerre en Ukraine

en.title: Vladimir Putin's party projected to win first elections since Ukraine war
en.summary: Putin's United Russia party is expected to win Sunday's legislative elections. The voting took place amid Ukrainian drone attacks and cyberattacks.

stories.title: Super League: 9. Runde – Lugano festigt Tabellenführung dank Verteidiger Delcroix' 3 Toren

en.title: Super League: Round 9 – Lugano solidifies first place thanks to defender Delcroix's 3 goals
en.summary: League leader Lugano defeated Lausanne 4-0, with defender Hannes Delcroix scoring three goals in the victory.

stories.title: Super League - Surclassé par Lugano, Lausanne enchaîne un 8e match sans victoire

en.title: Super League - Overwhelmed by Lugano, Lausanne extends eight-match winless streak
en.summary: Lausanne suffered a 4-0 defeat to Super League leader Lugano while playing with ten players from the 50th minute onward, extending their winless run to eight matches.

stories.title: Der Schweiz drohen happige Aufschläge bei neuen Medikamenten

en.title: Switzerland faces significant markups on new medications
en.summary: The United States no longer tolerates Switzerland obtaining substantially cheaper medication prices, creating an opportunity for the pharmaceutical industry to increase its share of healthcare spending.

stories.title: Brasiliens Wirtschaft wächst. Doch für viele Unternehmer ist eine vierte Amtszeit Lulas das Horrorszenario

en.title: Brazil's economy grows. But for many entrepreneurs, a fourth term for Lula is a nightmare scenario
en.summary: Brazil's economy is expanding, though business leaders express concerns about a potential fourth term for President Lula. Flávio Bolsonaro's economic program has not yet persuaded the business elite, despite their interest in a change of power in Brasília.

stories.title: «Nackt kündigen» – junge Chinesen entfliehen dem Druck im Job

en.title: "Naked resignation" – young Chinese escape job pressure
en.summary: Young Chinese workers are increasingly rejecting the intense career pressures of their society, stepping away from professional advancement. This trend reflects a broader erosion of China's traditional promise of upward mobility among younger generations.

stories.title: INTERVIEW - «Putin läuft die Lebenszeit davon», sagt der frühere BND-Chef. Er rechnet daher mit einer baldigen Eskalation

en.title: INTERVIEW - "Putin is running out of time," says former BND chief. He therefore expects an imminent escalation
en.summary: A former German foreign intelligence service director believes Putin faces time constraints and predicts near-term escalation. He argues that German intelligence should be permitted to sabotage foreign weapons manufacturing facilities.

stories.title: GASTKOMMENTAR - Europa konnte sich nur so lange als Leitbild für die Welt ausgeben, wie es sich noch in der Position des Überlegenen wähnen durfte – das ist heute nicht mehr der Fall

en.title: GUEST COMMENTARY - Europe could only serve as a role model for the world as long as it could imagine itself in a position of superiority – that is no longer the case today
en.summary: Europe's influence as a global model has diminished as it can no longer maintain its former position of superiority. Eastern European nations that hoped for a strong Europe to provide security after 1989 encountered instead a Western Europe defined by self-criticism rather than promise.
